facts.fact: Banks use the Home Affairs Online Verification Service, upgraded on 1 July 2025 to cut the failure rate below 1%, with Capitec, FNB and Standard Bank signed up to verify customers against the department's database in real time.
The old model limited Home Affairs bank-branch services to 30 branches across five banks, and Capitec plans 100 branches by early 2026 and 300 by mid-2026, against a target of 1,000 by 2029.

note: Facts dated to the 1 July 2025 upgrade and the August 2025 article.
